note: Ledger for tests/browser_audit_regressions.cjs. A defect listed under 'open' MUST reproduce; a defect not listed MUST NOT. Either mismatch fails the run. The fix for a defect removes its id here in the same change. Probes trigger update checks the way a returning tab does; the 'online' event is avoided because the phone code redraws on it, which hid B2 and B3 in an early version of this suite.

defects.A1: Generate, then ban a suggested hero, then apply: the banned hero enters allied locks (ui.js apply handler)
defects.A2: Mobile Undo restores a ban without invalidating generated alternatives (mobile.js undo handler)
defects.A3: Clearing enemies leaves alternatives generated under the old constraints on screen (ui.js clear-enemies)
defects.A4: Removing a ban leaves alternatives generated under the old constraints on screen (ui.js unban)
defects.A5: GUARD: applying an alternative still works when nothing changed, and the applied picks have unique heroes and roles
defects.A6: GUARD: replacing one role (substitution) still works from current alternatives and records its own inputs
defects.A7: GUARD: a saved draft that already contains a banned locked hero is repaired on load; the ban and every other valid pick are kept
defects.A8: GUARD: when alternatives are cleared because inputs changed, the panel says why
defects.A9: GUARD: changing the combination size or the enemy lineup never leaves alternatives from the old inputs on screen
